What we found:
You have had blood in stool for 30 days [1]. This usually settles within 14 days, so it should be tested now instead of treated again [1].

What happens next:
You need a colonoscopy, fit test, and per rectal exam [1]. Come back in 28 days with your reports [1].

Come back if:
You cough, pass blood, cannot swallow, lose more weight, or feel much worse [1].
